evidence.locator: text: Section 2(b), Section 2(d), and the three whole-work/aggregation paragraphs following Section 2(d) (the license combines whole-work copyleft for distributed or published derivative/collective works with a conditional network source-request duty; the single-valued copyleftScope vocabulary cannot represent both dimensions, so network records the distinctive added scope)

text: introductory paragraph identifying Section 2(d) as the network addition; Preamble; Sections 2(b) and 2(d) (reciprocal licensing plus preservation of a network source-request facility identify conditional network copyleft)

text: Section 1 and Sections 2(a) and 2(c) (copy-level copyright, warranty, and license notices; dated modification notices; and, for qualifying interactive modified programs, an on-run announcement with copyright, warranty, redistribution, and license-viewing information create a material notice burden)

text: Section 1; Sections 2(a)-2(d) and the whole-work paragraphs following Section 2(d); Sections 3(a)-3(c); Section 6; and Section 9, final paragraph (preserve notices and license text, mark changes, license qualifying whole works under this License, provide corresponding source on object-code distribution, and preserve an inherited network source-request facility with immediate HTTP source transmission; Section 9 separately permits qualifying modified versions under GNU GPL v3+, so neither the conditional network duty nor that alternative to same-license is losslessly expressible and unknown is retained)

text: Preamble, final patent paragraph, and Section 7 in full (the text states a policy against restrictive patent licenses and bars distribution when conflicting conditions cannot be satisfied, but contains neither an express patent grant nor patent-assertion termination)

text: Section 0, second paragraph; Section 1, both paragraphs; Section 2, opening paragraph; Sections 4 and 6 (running is unrestricted; source copying and distribution, charging a transfer fee, and modification are permitted; Section 4 does not itself grant sublicensing and Section 6 instead gives recipients a license directly from the original licensor; no express patent grant appears)

text: Section 6, second sentence; Sections 7 and 8; Sections 11-12 (no further restrictions may be imposed; conflicting patent or other conditions can prevent distribution and an original licensor may add a geographic limitation; warranty is disclaimed and liability limited)

text: Sections 1-3, especially Section 2 opening, Section 2(b), Section 2(d), and the whole-work/aggregation paragraphs following Section 2(d) (distribution and qualifying modification or combination activate conditions; network use matters only when the received network-interactive Program already offered source requests and the modified version is used through a network; linking is not separately stated, and the vocabulary cannot encode these conjunctive predicates, so unknown is retained)
